name: False Knight
description: The first major boss most Knights encounter. False Knight is a hulking, armored husk who charges and slams the arena, revealing the fragile Failed Champion within once his shell cracks.

name: Hornet Protector
description: A swift, needle-wielding guardian who tests reflexes with rapid thread and silk attacks. Hornet fights fair, offering warnings before her deadliest moves.

name: Crystal Guardian
description: A colossal beast encased in gleaming crystal that erupts from the mine floor, firing shard barrages and slamming its massive claws across the arena.

name: Soul Master
description: A once-brilliant scholar consumed by the pursuit of the Soul. He teleports across the arena, conjuring orbiting orbs and raining down arcane bolts.

name: Broken Vessel
description: A cracked husk infested with the Infection, spawning parasitic minions and lashing out with sweeping needle strikes born of primal, unstable movement.

name: Watcher Knights
description: A pair of animated royal guardians that fight in tandem, their long spears sweeping and thrusting in coordinated patterns that punish hesitation.

name: Mantis Lords
description: Three deadly, honor-bound warriors who battle one at a time, striking with elegant, blade-fast precision that demands flawless timing.

name: The Hollow Knight
description: The vessel sealed to contain the Radiance's Infection, twisted into a nightmarish final guardian. A relentless, multi-phase battle testing everything learned.
